scope: Real PostgreSQL scoped signer refusals, plus read-only public code checks for immutable retained bindings.

checks.name: unknown actor and unexpected contract target are denied before chain or key access
player cannot mint payment tokens or native-backed NFTs
token and NFT approvals enforce permitted spender and finite amount caps
native value and per-call gas budget escapes are denied
registrar publisher inspector and lender privileges remain separated
marketplace signer refuses lending, bank token/NFT approvals and GEM before RPC or key access
marketplace refuses historical bank broadcast and reconciliation before RPC or key access
retained intent rejects changed owner and calldata before key access
